# SchoolOS Operating Bible — Roles × Domains × Doors (how everything works, with examples)

> Date 2026-10-03 · Schools: **Saraswati Vidya Mandir Kothrud** (populated: 38 pupils, 28 accounts, 29/29 modules) + **Shree Samarth Vidyalaya sdmhtr** (empty control).
> Method: browser-verified flows + parsed route registries. Core doors: **186**. Plugin doors: **246**. Surfaces mapped: **120**.
> Gist: every role GENERATES specific rows through its doors (data + audit + outbox in one transaction) and VIEWS others' rows through scoped reads. Examples use the genuine roster (Aarav Joshi Nursery-A … Vaishnavi Shinde 10-B) and staff (Meera … Kavita).
> Analytics today: mostly EMPTY by honest design (fresh lanes show zeros/—/gates, never demo numbers). §5 lists per-domain state + what fills it + example computed output.

## 0. Data legend (the running example)
- Tenant `saraswati-vidya-mandir-kothrud` (`e7784572…`); year `2026-27` (2026-06-01→2027-05-31, current).
- Classes 13×23 (Nursery/A … 10/A,B); subjects 11 (ENG MAR HIN MAT SCI SST CS ART PE MUS SAN).
- Pupils e.g. Om Shelar 5-A (SVM2026-021, bus Route-3, guardian Rohit Shelar +91 98221 50001), Shreya Iyer 5-A (SVM2026-022, absent 2026-10-03 → 1 queued notice).
- Money in paise (₹4,500 = 450000c); fines ₹5/day = 500c; loans 14d student / 21d teacher; GPS 30d; delay guard 10m.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <memory-only>`; every door re-checks JWT+jti+live row+role+RLS. 403s carry human copy + required roles.

## 1. Roles — each role: who, login, what they GENERATE, what they VIEW, what they CANNOT do, handovers

### 1.1 `owner` — Meera Deshpande `<meera.deshpande@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Founder/Correspondent. Chose her own password (force_change=false). Home: /owner/home + /today. Home: `/owner/home`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=owner; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 341 doors (178 writes, 163 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).

  - `POST /billing/webhook', async (req, reply) => {
    const secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '';
    if (!secret) return reply.code(503).send({ error: 'Billing webhooks are not configured on this deployment' });
    const raw = req.rawBody ?? Buffer.from(typeof req.body === 'string' ? req.body : JSON.stringify(req.body ?? {}));
    const sig = String(req.headers['x-razorpay-signature'] ?? '');
    let ok = false;
    try {
      const { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } = await import('node:crypto');
      const want = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(raw).digest('hex');
      ok = sig.length === want.length && timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sig), Buffer.from(want));
    } catch { ok = false; }
    if (!ok) return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'bad signature' });
    const body = typeof req.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw.toString('utf8')) : (req.body ?? {});
    if (body?.event !== 'payment.captured') return { ok: true, ignored: body?.event ?? 'unknown' };
    const gwOrderId = body?.payload?.payment?.entity?.order_id ?? null;
    if (!gwOrderId) return { ok: true, ignored: 'no-order' };
    const hit = await sysq(`SELECT id, tenant_id, plan, status FROM app.billing_orders WHERE gateway_order_id=$1`, [gwOrderId]);
    const order = hit.rows[0];
    if (!order || order.status === 'paid') return { ok: true, ignored: 'unknown-or-duplicate' };
    await sysq(`UPDATE app.billing_orders SET status='paid', paid_at=now() WHERE id=$1`, [order.id]);
    await sysq(`UPDATE app.tenants SET plan=$1 WHERE id=$2`, [order.plan, order.tenant_id]);
    return { ok: true, plan: order.plan };
  });

- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - Creates principal + school profile + enables modules + approves announcements/certificates + confirms money + activates year — every act audited with policyRef.
- **Worked example (Meera's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.2 `principal` — Vandana Joshi `<vandana.joshi@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Academic head. Only the owner could create her (server 403 otherwise). Temp sun-leaf-7fd1, forced change on first login. Home: /principal/home + /today. Home: `/principal/home`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=principal; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.

- **CANNOT do (refusals with copy)**: owner-only doors (`POST principal create`, school patch, payment confirm, year activate) → `403 Only the school owner…`; unassigned-class marking → `403 No class is assigned…`; cross-tenant anything → RLS empty; unknown path → friendly NotFound (FIX-8); OFF-plugin doors → `409 …switched off — ask the owner…`; self-approve own case/announcement → SoD `403`.
- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - Assigns classes (ownership authority) → teachers can mark; approves announcements/cases; moderation→publish exam snapshots.
- **Worked example (Vandana's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.3 `coordinator` — Rahul Patil `<rahul.patil@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Timetable + substitutions + class assignments. Father-figure of Std 1-B? No — coordinator owns no register; office fallback for marking. Home: /coord/home. Home: `/coord/home`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=coordinator; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 256 doors (112 writes, 144 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).
- **GENERATES (writer doors — each with example)**:
  - `PATCH /plugins/admissions.funnel/leads/:id` — gate `admissions,coordinator,finance,itadmin,owner,principal` · uuid id · plugin:admissions.funnel.
    Why: the coordinator fires this from its desk form/button; tenant comes from the token (never the body); RLS + audit + outbox ride the same transaction.
  - `POST /plugins/admissions.funnel/leads` — gate `admissions,coordinator,finance,itadmin,owner,principal` · plugin:admissions.funnel.

  - Reviews substitutions (leave→suggest→assign), workload board, curriculum monitor, escalations queue, approval center.
- **Worked example (Rahul's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.4 `counselor` — Sneha Pawar `<sneha.pawar@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Wellbeing + safety-box designated reader (HUMAN-ONLY safeguarding; teachers can never read anonymous reports). Home: /counselor/concerns. Home: `/counselor/concerns`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=counselor; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`.   - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).

  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).

- **Who**: Finance head. Writes fee settings, confirms settlements, runs Tally export + late-fees. Father of Aditya (1-A) and Vaishnavi (10-B) — SoD still applies to his own children. Home: /fees. Home: `/fees`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO.   - `POST /billing/webhook', async (req, reply) => {
    const secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '';
    if (!secret) return reply.code(503).send({ error: 'Billing webhooks are not configured on this deployment' });
    const raw = req.rawBody ?? Buffer.from(typeof req.body === 'string' ? req.body : JSON.stringify(req.body ?? {}));
    const sig = String(req.headers['x-razorpay-signature'] ?? '');
    let ok = false;
    try {
      const { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } = await import('node:crypto');
      const want = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(raw).digest('hex');
      ok = sig.length === want.length && timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sig), Buffer.from(want));
    } catch { ok = false; }
    if (!ok) return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'bad signature' });
    const body = typeof req.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw.toString('utf8')) : (req.body ?? {});
    if (body?.event !== 'payment.captured') return { ok: true, ignored: body?.event ?? 'unknown' };
    const gwOrderId = body?.payload?.payment?.entity?.order_id ?? null;
    if (!gwOrderId) return { ok: true, ignored: 'no-order' };
    const hit = await sysq(`SELECT id, tenant_id, plan, status FROM app.billing_orders WHERE gateway_order_id=$1`, [gwOrderId]);
    const order = hit.rows[0];
    if (!order || order.status === 'paid') return { ok: true, ignored: 'unknown-or-duplicate' };
    await sysq(`UPDATE app.billing_orders SET status='paid', paid_at=now() WHERE id=$1`, [order.id]);
    await sysq(`UPDATE app.tenants SET plan=$1 WHERE id=$2`, [order.plan, order.tenant_id]);
    return { ok: true, plan: order.plan };
  });

- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - Confirms payment → obligation settles → receipt PDF (tenant address/board) → Insights collection% moves; Insights aging shrinks; audit keeps void history.
- **Worked example (Anil's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.7 `finance_clerk` — Pooja Jadhav `<pooja.jadhav@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Finance clerk. Records + receipts + concession paperwork; cannot confirm settlements (finance_head/owner only). Home: /fees. Home: `/fees`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=finance_clerk; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 59 doors (15 writes, 44 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).
- **GENERATES (writer doors — each with example)**:
  - `POST /plugins/payments.razorpay/orders` — gate `finance,finance_clerk,finance_head,owner,principal` · plugin:payments.razorpay.
    Why: the finance_clerk fires this from its desk form/button; tenant comes from the token (never the body); RLS + audit + outbox ride the same transaction.

- **CANNOT do (refusals with copy)**: owner-only doors (`POST principal create`, school patch, payment confirm, year activate) → `403 Only the school owner…`; unassigned-class marking → `403 No class is assigned…`; cross-tenant anything → RLS empty; unknown path → friendly NotFound (FIX-8); OFF-plugin doors → `409 …switched off — ask the owner…`; self-approve own case/announcement → SoD `403`.
- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - Confirms payment → obligation settles → receipt PDF (tenant address/board) → Insights collection% moves; Insights aging shrinks; audit keeps void history.
- **Worked example (Pooja's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.8 `admissions` — Nitin Gaikwad `<nitin.gaikwad@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Funnel owner: lead capture → stages → offer/accept → enrol. Holds POST /students with coordinator/principal/owner/itadmin. Home: /admissions. Home: `/admissions`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=admissions; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 60 doors (22 writes, 38 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).

- **CANNOT do (refusals with copy)**: owner-only doors (`POST principal create`, school patch, payment confirm, year activate) → `403 Only the school owner…`; unassigned-class marking → `403 No class is assigned…`; cross-tenant anything → RLS empty; unknown path → friendly NotFound (FIX-8); OFF-plugin doors → `409 …switched off — ask the owner…`; self-approve own case/announcement → SoD `403`.
- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - GPS delay≥10m → approval action → guardian notice draft (never auto-send) → coordinator/principal approve in Action Center.
- **Worked example (Vijay's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.10 `facilities` — Prakash Lokhande `<prakash.lokhande@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: Assets + work orders + vendors requester. Father of Pari (2-B). Home: /maintenance. Home: `/maintenance`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=facilities; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 50 doors (15 writes, 35 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).

- **Who**: 14 class teachers, each owning registers via app.class_assignments (e.g. Deepak→1-A; father of Yash 6-A). Marks only owned classes; homework; leave. Home: /teacher. Home: `/teacher`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=teacher; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 116 doors (39 writes, 77 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).

  - EX `POST /plugins/library/loans/:id/renew-request` e.g. req `{"bookId":"<Wings of Fire>","copyId":"LIB-00007","memberId":"<Om Shelar>","dueOn":"+14d"}` → resp `{loan open} one-open-loan-per-copy; return computes ₹5/day UTC fine once; holds FIFO; fines ledger`.
  - EX `POST /plugins/ops.timetable/attendance/autofill` e.g. req `{"grade":"5","section":"A","day":1,"period":2,"subject":"Mathematics","teacherId":"<Divya Menon>"}` → resp `{slot} + substitution suggestions on leave; period-autofill for attendance`.
  - EX `POST /attendance/mark` e.g. req `{"date":"2026-10-03","marks":[{"studentId":"<uuid Om Shelar>","status":"present"},{"studentId":"<uuid Shreya Iyer>","status":"absent"}]}` → resp `{ok,marked:2,absent:1,noticesQueued:1} + per-change audit + ABSENCE_NOTICE queued (never auto-sent)`.
  - EX `POST /cases` e.g. req `{"title":"Bus 14 bullying complaint","severity":"high","studentId":"<uuid>"}` → resp `{case} triage chain; author cannot approve own (SoD); safeguarding HUMAN-ONLY`.
  - EX `POST /cases/:id/status` e.g. req `{"title":"Bus 14 bullying complaint","severity":"high","studentId":"<uuid>"}` → resp `{case} triage chain; author cannot approve own (SoD); safeguarding HUMAN-ONLY`.
  - EX `POST /work-orders` e.g. req `{"assetId":"<24 fans>","title":"Fan wobble 6-A","priority":"medium"}` → resp `{workOrder} → technician executes → closes; preventive AMC schedules; vendors paid off-system, Tally export`.

- **CANNOT do (refusals with copy)**: owner-only doors (`POST principal create`, school patch, payment confirm, year activate) → `403 Only the school owner…`; unassigned-class marking → `403 No class is assigned…`; cross-tenant anything → RLS empty; unknown path → friendly NotFound (FIX-8); OFF-plugin doors → `409 …switched off — ask the owner…`; self-approve own case/announcement → SoD `403`.
- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - Marks register → parent sees child row live; principal sees school %; fees nothing; transport delay notices reference guardian phones the office keeps.
- **Worked example (Deepak's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

### 1.13 `itadmin` — Sandeep Kulkarni `<sandeep.kulkarni@svm-kothrud.edu.in>`
- **Who**: First checklist hire. Provisions staff, API keys, plugin settings; cannot create principals (owner-only). Home: /it + /people-admin. Home: `/it`.
- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. Provisioned accounts arrive `force_change=true` → first login `403 mustChange` + RESTRICTED token → `/account/password` (verified live for UI Teacher Three). JWT carries sub/role/tenant/name/jti/ep with role=itadmin; logout revokes jti + `Clear-Site-Data`. Same email in 2 tenants → `409 choose-your-school`. Step-up (`POST /me/step-up`, 5-min) for disable/grant/erasure.
- **Reach**: 263 doors (114 writes, 149 reads). Writes always commit data+audit(hash-chain)+outbox(event) atomically; reads are live joins (no stale copies).

  - `GET /public/disclosure', async (req, reply) => {
    const slug = typeof req.query?.tenant === 'string' ? req.query.tenant.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 80) : '';
    if (!slug) return bad(reply, 'tenant query (school code) is required');
    const t = await sysq(`SELECT id, name, slug FROM app.tenants WHERE slug=$1`, [slug]);
    const tenant = t.rows[0];
    if (!tenant) return reply.code(404).send({ error: 'No school with that code' });
    const docs = (await sysq(
      `SELECT name, kind, expires_on FROM app.mpd_docs WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND active ORDER BY kind`,
      [tenant.id])).rows;
    return { school: { name: tenant.name, slug: tenant.slug }, disclosures: docs, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  });

  - Provisions staff (temps, force_change) → everyone else can exist; rotates API keys (/it); edits plugin settings (secrets never surfaced).

  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

- **Login/session**: Email+password (scrypt) | phone OTP (E.164, dev echo) | Google SSO. - **Screens**: home `/library/desk`; sidebar/palette/tabbar filtered by `GET /me/effective` (`canSurface`); `Guard` fails closed with honest copy; `KernelGate` hides OFF modules (owner/itadmin get Turn-on). Light roles (parent/student) get chromeless planes.
- **Renderable surfaces** (surface door reachable → screen renders; `*` unknown → NotFound copy per FIX-8):
  - `/account/password` via `GET /me` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/attendance` via `GET /attendance` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/library` via `GET /plugins/library/catalog` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/library/desk` via `GET /plugins/library/desk/overview` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/library/insights` via `GET /plugins/library/ops/overview` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/people` via `GET /students` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/people/:id` via `GET /students/:id` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/plugins` via `GET /plugins` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/settings` via `GET /me` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
  - `/transport` via `GET /transport/routes` — renders because this role holds the door; every action inside re-gates per click.
- **CANNOT do (refusals with copy)**: owner-only doors (`POST principal create`, school patch, payment confirm, year activate) → `403 Only the school owner…`; unassigned-class marking → `403 No class is assigned…`; cross-tenant anything → RLS empty; unknown path → friendly NotFound (FIX-8); OFF-plugin doors → `409 …switched off — ask the owner…`; self-approve own case/announcement → SoD `403`.
- **HANDOVERS (data this role makes that others consume)**:
  - Issues loan → borrower/teacher sees due; return computes fine → fines ledger → Insights? no (library reports); holds FIFO auto-offers next borrower.
- **Worked example (Kavita's Tuesday)**: signs in via UI (`POST /auth/login 200` → `GET /me|/me/effective|/dataset|/plugins`), opens home, performs one write above (audited, evented), watches the consumer screen update on next hydrate (no refresh tricks — live reads).
  - 08:00 — cold open `/today`: AuthGate `POST /auth/renew` (cookie same-origin; 401 probe in split-origin dev) → login card → fill + Sign in → `POST /auth/login 200` → hydrate `/me`, `/me/effective`, `/dataset`, `/plugins`.
  - 08:05 — sidebar shows only surfaces this role's doors unlock (`canSurface`); OFF modules hidden or Turn-on (owner/itadmin).
  - 08:10 — performs the day's write (form → door → 200 → temp/ack shown once where applicable → list refresh fires the 3 list doors).
  - 08:12 — audit row + outbox event land in the same transaction; outbox-worker relays, comms-dispatcher drains any queued notices (logger in dev).
  - 08:15 — consumer role opens their screen (scoped read) and sees the row; Insights/summaries move on next hydrate (≤60s where cached).
  - Failure branches tried: wrong password → 401 copy; expired bearer → login?return round-trip back here; OFF plugin → 409 turn-on; foreign-tenant id → 404/RLS-empty; own-approve → SoD 403.

## 3. Doors — every door: gate, purpose, example, audit/event, errors, UI caller

### 3.1 `GET /me` [kernel]
- **Gate**: `all 16 roles (open-authed read)`. JWT+jti+live-row+role+RLS on every call; custom-role masks widen/narrow via `GET /me/effective` (render hint only — the server re-decides).
- **Example request**: `{…scoped fields…}`.
- **Example response**: `{row} + audit + event (writes) / live rows (reads)`.
- **Tenant/RLS**: tenant_id comes from the token; cross-tenant ids 404 (row invisible outside the GUC wall).
- **Write contract**: data row + `auditLog` (hash-chain: actor/role/action/reason/policyRef/outcome) + `emitEvent` (`app.events` human spine + `app.outbox` machine envelope) in ONE transaction.
- **Read contract**: live SQL at read time (joins + scopes); no snapshots (exam publish excepted); 60s/500-cap only on BI read models.
- **400s**: human validation — class-typo names the real list (P2-6); dup admission_no names the holder (P2-5); dup name refused (P2-8); bad dob/gender; >300 marks / >2MB CSV (413).
- **401/403/404/409s**: `401` disabled/bad token; `403` role copy + required roles (principal-create owner-only; unassigned marking; SoD self-approve; student whole-register SEC-3); `404` foreign id; `409` OFF-plugin lifecycle (`…switched off — ask the owner…`), dup UNIQUE, single-current year.
- **UI caller**: `/settings`, `/account/password`
- **Pre-handler**: `preHandler: me`
- **Who generates vs views**: writers above create the rows named here; every other role with a reader door views them under its scope (parent/student pinned, staff tenant-wide, teachers class-owned).

### 3.28 `GET /public/disclosure', async (req, reply) => {
    const slug = typeof req.query?.tenant === 'string' ? req.query.tenant.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 80) : '';
    if (!slug) return bad(reply, 'tenant query (school code) is required');
    const t = await sysq(`SELECT id, name, slug FROM app.tenants WHERE slug=$1`, [slug]);
    const tenant = t.rows[0];
    if (!tenant) return reply.code(404).send({ error: 'No school with that code' });
    const docs = (await sysq(
      `SELECT name, kind, expires_on FROM app.mpd_docs WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND active ORDER BY kind`,
      [tenant.id])).rows;
    return { school: { name: tenant.name, slug: tenant.slug }, disclosures: docs, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  });

  // RTE §12(1)(c): the 25% quota lives on the roster (source='rte-lottery') + an auto-approved
  // statutory waiver, so reimbursement, fee and audit all read the same truth.

### 3.37 `POST /billing/webhook', async (req, reply) => {
    const secret = process.env.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? '';
    if (!secret) return reply.code(503).send({ error: 'Billing webhooks are not configured on this deployment' });
    const raw = req.rawBody ?? Buffer.from(typeof req.body === 'string' ? req.body : JSON.stringify(req.body ?? {}));
    const sig = String(req.headers['x-razorpay-signature'] ?? '');
    let ok = false;
    try {
      const { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } = await import('node:crypto');
      const want = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(raw).digest('hex');
      ok = sig.length === want.length && timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(sig), Buffer.from(want));
    } catch { ok = false; }
    if (!ok) return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'bad signature' });
    const body = typeof req.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw.toString('utf8')) : (req.body ?? {});
    if (body?.event !== 'payment.captured') return { ok: true, ignored: body?.event ?? 'unknown' };
    const gwOrderId = body?.payload?.payment?.entity?.order_id ?? null;
    if (!gwOrderId) return { ok: true, ignored: 'no-order' };
    const hit = await sysq(`SELECT id, tenant_id, plan, status FROM app.billing_orders WHERE gateway_order_id=$1`, [gwOrderId]);
    const order = hit.rows[0];
    if (!order || order.status === 'paid') return { ok: true, ignored: 'unknown-or-duplicate' };
    await sysq(`UPDATE app.billing_orders SET status='paid', paid_at=now() WHERE id=$1`, [order.id]);
    await sysq(`UPDATE app.tenants SET plan=$1 WHERE id=$2`, [order.plan, order.tenant_id]);
    return { ok: true, plan: order.plan };
  });

  // ---- Master Action Plan batch 2 · infra, meetings, health, CPD, PINs, acks, 360, templates ----
  // Counter-PIN enrollment: hash-only (like passwords — the ledger never sees a digit).
  app.post('/fees/pins` [kernel]

## 4. End-to-end flows — one record's life across roles (generate → view → act)

### 4.1 Admission→register→absence notice
Nitin (admissions) captures walk-in Kavya Bhosale 1 (lead) → stages → offer/accept → enrol `POST /students` (P2-6/5/8 guards) → guardian phone matches provisioned parent → child_link → Deepak (1-A owner) marks her present; sick day absent → `ABSENCE_NOTICE queued` → Sneha? no — guardian gets it after office send; Vandana sees school %; Insights presence moves; audit shows 5 rows (lead, stage×3, enrol, mark).
- hop1: lead captured (event admission.enquiry.captured + rule→followup pipeline, no SMS)
- hop2: offer letter (session-bound owner)
- hop3: accept + enrol INSERT + guardians + child_link + audit + event
- hop4: register mark (upsert + per-change audit)
- hop5: notice queued (comms, logger in dev)
- hop6: read-backs: parent child-only, teacher owned-class, principal school

### 4.2 Fee→receipt→analytics
Anil (finance_head) creates TUIT head + plan 2026-27-T1 → generate fans to 38 actives (idempotent key) → Pooja (clerk) records Om ₹4,500 UPI pending → Anil confirms → receipt PDF (tenant board/address) → Insights collection% 0→moves, aging shrinks; void keeps history (paid_cents↗ never).
- hop1: heads/plans/generate (D-5/D-21 guarded)
- hop2: record pending (any of parent/finance/owner)
- hop3: confirm settles (head/owner only)
- hop4: receipt + PDF + audit×3
- hop5: summaries recompute live (60s cache)

### 4.3 Leave→substitution→register
Amit (3-A) `POST /teacher/leave` 10-09→10 → kernel action teacher.leave.<id> → Rahul (coordinator) reviews workload board → assigns Suresh → substitution feed + duty update → register markable by substitute; audit each step.
- hop1: request (event staff.leave.requested)
- hop2: suggest (timetable-aware)
- hop3: decide (coordinator door)
- hop4: feed + classroom handover packet

### 4.4 Book→loan→fine→hold
Kavita catalogs Wings of Fire → LIB-00007 → issues to Om +14d → Om returns +3d → 1500c fine → waive/settle → pending hold auto-offers next (FIFO); owner sees aggregates only (overdue 403 by design).
- hop1: catalog+copy (accession scheme)
- hop2: issue (caps: 2 student/5 teacher, one-open-per-copy)
- hop3: return UTC-math once
- hop4: ledger + acquisition votes

### 4.5 Enquiry→enrol (funnel honesty)
Same as flow 1 lead half, stressing: NO auto-SMS at capture (rule fans out only an outbox follow-up task); every guardian message needs approval + DLT in prod.
- hop1: capture validates phone E.164
- hop2: pipeline task (human calls)
- hop3: visit → offer → accept
- hop4: enrol converts (same guards as manual)

### 4.6 Visitor→pickup OTP
Reception pre-regs grandparent→Shreya 5-A → check-in badge → pickup OTP 482913 checked against guardians∪child_link → out. Stranger OTP → 403, no child named.
- hop1: pre-reg
- hop2: in/out log
- hop3: OTP verify (H2 union)
- hop4: audit visit chain

### 4.7 GPS delay→approval
Vijay's Route-3 GPS ingests (30d) → 12m delay → approval-required action (never auto-notify) → principal approves → guardian draft sends via logger/BSP → timeline entry.
- hop1: positions
- hop2: guard ≥10m
- hop3: approve (Action Center)
- hop4: send + receipt

### 4.8 Concern→intervention
Divya files concern (Shreya withdrawn) → coordinator routes → Sneha (counselor) intervenes (plan lifecycle) → teacher sees status, never safety-box identities; anonymous safety → no identity stored, serious → page principal.
- hop1: file + event concern.filed
- hop2: route (designee)
- hop3: plan + append-only events
- hop4: PTM books, notes stay teacher-private

### 4.9 Homework→grade
Divya posts 5-A Maths Ex4.2 Fri → Om submits once as-self (second refused) → late auto → Divya reviews (assigner-only) 8/10 + feedback → inbox moves pending→reviewed → completion% recomputes.
- hop1: post (class×subject×due)
- hop2: submit (self-only)
- hop3: review (owner-teacher only)
- hop4: analytics

### 4.10 Announcement→guardians
Principal drafts Diwali break → owner approves (APPROVAL posture) → publishes → dispatcher fans to audiences (guardians∪staff) → receipts; unapproved drafts never send (audit-before-send).
- hop1: draft
- hop2: approve (owner/principal)
- hop3: fan-out (budgets)
- hop4: receipts + memory

### 4.11 Class assignment (principal office)
Vandana assigns Deepak→1-A (`POST /class-assignments`): prior holder retired (partial unique), handover audited; Deepak's marking 403s vanish; unassigned 9/10-B stay office-marked.
- hop1: pick teacher (minimal id+name+role, P2-15)
- hop2: assign (retire prior, audit handover)
- hop3: teacher marks owned register
- hop4: Insights drill attributes the class

### 4.12 Year activation (owner)
Meera creates 2026-27 then activates: previous current retires in-tx (`FOR UPDATE`), partial unique holds single-current; fee/exam/promotion scoping follows the new id.
- hop1: create (not current)
- hop2: activate (retire previous, event)
- hop3: plans scope to year
- hop4: promotions read it

### 4.13 SAR fulfilment (two-person)
Guardian requests export → office verifies identity → second approver confirms → export zip (scoped rows only) → erase where granted → journal entry; SLA clock 30d visible in queue.
- hop1: request (append-only)
- hop2: verify + second approve
- hop3: export/erase
- hop4: journal + retention hooks

### 4.14 PTM booking (teacher→parent)
Anjali publishes 7-A slots → guardian books one → teacher-private notes (RLS-pinned) → reminder queued → meeting → outcome note; double-book refused.
- hop1: publish slots
- hop2: book (guardian, own child)
- hop3: remind (dispatcher)
- hop4: private notes (never shared)

## 5. Analytics today — per-domain state (mostly empty, honestly) + what fills it + example output

### 5.1 Roster/roll
- POPULATED (38 pupils, 28 accounts, 13×23, 11 subjects). Fills: admissions. Ex: `GET /students?grade=5&section=A` → 2 rows (Om, Shreya) with admission_no/dob/guardian/bus.

### 5.2 Attendance health
- THIN (6 marks on 2026-10-03: 5-A 1/2, 10-A 2/2, 1-A 2/2-ish). Fills: daily marking per register. Ex: `GET /plugins/ops.bi/attendance?days=30` → `{byClass:[{grade:5,marks:2,present:1,pct:50}],belowThreshold:[5-A]}`
- empty school → 409 gate + `—/no registers`.

### 5.3 Fees
- HEADS-ONLY (3 heads, 0 obligations). Fills: plans→generate→payments→confirms. Ex empty now: `GET /reports/fees/summary` → `{obligations:0,billed:0,collected:0,outstanding:0,collectionPct:null}`
- populated later e.g. 38×450000c billed, 12 paid → 31.6%.

### 5.4 Timetable coverage
- EMPTY (no slots). Fills: coordinator slot writes. Ex later: `{slotsToday:48, coverage:100%, subs:2}` + substitution feed rows.

### 5.5 Transport
- ROUTES-ONLY (4 routes, assignments via bus_route, no GPS). Fills: GPS ingest + delays. Ex later: `{onTime:93%, approvals:1, riders:31}`.

### 5.6 Library
- EMPTY (no books). Fills: catalog→copies→loans. Ex later: `{circulation:42, overdue:3, finesOpen:1500c}` + desk tables.

### 5.7 Admissions
- EMPTY (no leads). Fills: capture→stages. Ex later: `{conversion:22%, stageAging:{contacted:6}}`.

### 5.8 HR/duty
- EMPTY. Fills: leave requests + roster. Ex later: `{pending:2, subCoverage:100%}`.

### 5.9 Clinic
- EMPTY. Fills: passes. Ex later: `{visits:5, fever:2}`.

### 5.10 Exams
- EMPTY. Fills: marks→moderation→publish. Ex later: `{pass:96%, Maths avg 71}` + mastery maps (decay A3).

### 5.11 Cases/incidents
- EMPTY. Fills: raises + triage. Ex later: `{open:3, slaRisk:1}`
- SoD refusals logged.

### 5.12 Maintenance
- EMPTY (assets seeded? none yet). Fills: WOs + closes. Ex later: `{sla:98%, open:4}` + map pins.

### 5.13 Comms
- QUEUED (absence notice×1 + follow-ups). Fills: sends. Ex: receipts `{queued:1, sent:0(dev logger), failed:0}` + rails board sandbox flags.

### 5.14 Oversight/AI
- LIVE-EMPTY (0 calls/tokens
- budgets 200/200k). Fills: asks/drafts (budgeted, deterministic). Ex: `{calls:0, tokens:0}` — tokens stay 0 (no LLM).

### 5.15 Audit/memory
- POPULATED (every act above: signup, classes, 27 provisions, 38 admissions, marks, enables, 1 UI create, 1 suspend). Ex: `GET /audit` hash-chain rows with actor/role/reason/policyRef/outcome
- memory timeline streams them.

### 5.16 How an empty becomes live (the honest path, per lane)
- Each lane: define structure (classes/subjects/year) → enable module (`/plugins`, audited) → write first row via its UI form (same doors as §3) → read-back on its screen → analytics move on next hydrate (≤60s cache where noted).
- Never: demo numbers, fabricated zeros (trust receipt shows real `differenceCents`), silent 100% (unmarked register ≠ present), auto-sends (approval/dispatcher only).

### 5.17 Query recipes (copy the pattern, swap the ids — all live reads)
#### 5.17.1 Roster of 5-A — `GET /students?grade=5&section=A`
- Returns: 2 rows (Om, Shreya); phones hidden for non-staff roles.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.2 One pupil — `GET /students/:id (uuid)`
- Returns: full row + guardians + bus; 404 when foreign-tenant.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.3 Today's register — `GET /attendance?date=2026-10-03&grade=5&section=A`
- Returns: per-pupil status+note; null = unmarked (not present).
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.4 Parent's view — `GET /attendance (as guardian)`
- Returns: own children only via child_link (max 50); same shape, subset rows.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.5 Fee dues — `GET /fees/obligations?studentId=<uuid>`
- Returns: open dues with billed/paid/outstanding; voided excluded.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.6 Fee totals — `GET /reports/fees/summary`
- Returns: whole-ledger totals + collectionPct (null when nothing billed).
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.7 Fee aging — `GET /plugins/ops.bi/fees/aging`
- Returns: overdue-only buckets (contrast with whole-ledger summary).
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.8 Attendance health — `GET /plugins/ops.bi/attendance?days=30`
- Returns: byClass marks/present/late/pct + belowThreshold; 409 when plugin OFF.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.9 Timetable grid — `GET /plugins/ops.timetable/grid?grade=5&section=A`
- Returns: week cells {subject, teacher, room}; empty cells honest.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.10 Transport routes — `GET /transport/routes`
- Returns: 4 routes + stops + rider counts (assignments via bus_route).
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.11 Library catalog — `GET /plugins/library/books?q=wings`
- Returns: books + per-copy availability (derived from copies).
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.12 Overdue (desk) — `GET /plugins/library/overdue (librarian)`
- Returns: borrower-level overdue; owner 403 by design (aggregates elsewhere).
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.13 Funnel board — `GET /plugins/admissions.funnel/leads?stage=contacted`
- Returns: masked PII unless FULL_PII role; stage aging attached.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.14 Cases open — `GET /cases?status=open`
- Returns: triage chain per case; SoD enforced on approve.
- Auth/scoping: bearer + role + RLS as §3; parent/student pinned; teachers class-owned where applicable.

#### 5.17.15 Work orders — `GET /work-orders?status=open`
- Returns: hub/map/intelligence read the same rows.

- signup 1 + login/session (`/auth/login|/me|/me/effective|/me/tenants|/dataset|/plugins`) per cold open + renew-probe 401s (expected, Fix-1).
- per-screen hydrations: people-admin 3 (`onboard/status`, `users`, `classes`); fees 6; timetable 4; insights 2; classes 2; today 4; library desk per-tab; all 200 except honest 403/409 gates (Fix-3/4).

- zero `PAGEERROR`, zero crashes across 85+30 route-states; console errors only the 3 known classes.

### 8.3 Glossary (one line each)
- RLS: row-level security (tenant wall inside Postgres)
- GUC: session variable carrying tenant_id (+role) for RLS
- jti: JWT id, revoked at logout (denylist)
- force_change: must-change-password stamp on temp credentials
- SoD: segregation of duties (no self-approve)
- KernelGate: plugin on/off render gate (+owner Turn-on)
- Guard: role render gate from /me/effective
- DEFAULT_ON: the 4 born-enabled plugins
- logger rail: sandbox provider (log + ok, never fake delivery)
- D-5/D-21: paid_cents never decreases (money invariant)
- P2-5/6/7/8: admission guards (dup-no, real-class, dob/gender, dup-name)
- G-1/G-2: portal-bind (user_id) / parent phone+child link
- HUMAN-ONLY: safeguarding posture (humans decide, system routes)
- AUTO/APPROVAL: constitution postures for AI-proposed actions
- M1: guardians-table mirror at admission
- FEX-3: memory-only bearer (no localStorage token)
- FEX-5: unknown surface fails closed (FIX-8 renders NotFound copy)

### 8.5 Glossary additions
- lifecycleGate: OFF-plugin 409 guard with plain-language copy
- uuidParams: :id must be UUID (400 otherwise)
- SAVEPOINT pattern: UNIQUE→friendly 409 (never raw 500)
- idempotency key: (tenant,student,term,label) — regen skips
- partial unique index: one-current year / one-owner-per-class
- reference model: class_id/section_id trigger-kept from text
- structural match: phone-equality parent↔child binding (never names)
- dedup key: comms exactly-once per audience+template+day
- quiet hours: no non-urgent sends 21:00–08:00 IST
- single-current: exactly one academic year is_current
- T509: nothing assigned may vanish from nav (More bucket)
- RBAC-6/FE-2: client reads /me/effective, never invents permission

### 8.6 How this bible was built + how to regenerate
- Parsed: `server/src/routes.js` + `server/src/plugins/*/index.js` (single-quoted AND template `${ID}` paths; `...CONST` spreads resolved via file-local + `_shared/*` role arrays) + `SURFACE_DOOR` + `role-catalog.js`.
- Grounded in: browser walks v1/v2/v6/v7/v8/v9/v10/v11/v13/v15b (2,600+ log lines, 115+ route-states, zero crashes) + genuine roster (38 pupils, 28 accounts) + fresh-bundle verification.
- Regenerate: `python3 /tmp/gen10k.py` (docs-only; touches nothing else). Re-run after any route/role/plugin change per the docs law (`DATA-FLOW.md` + `ROLE-CAPABILITIES.md` + matrix via `server/scripts/permission-matrix.js`).
- Line target: ≥10,000 (this build aims ~10,300 to survive small registry shrinks).
